newsitem.title: USA: LHS Group Inc to price IPO shares higher.
newsitem.headline: LHS Group Inc to price IPO shares higher.

text.p: LHS Group Inc has filed to price shares of its initial public offering higher than originally expected, at $15 to $17 each.

In a document filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday, the company lifted the price range from its original estimate of $14 to $16 made in February. It still plans to offer 5,883,000 shares. Of the total number of shares, five million will be sold by the company with the remainder to be offered by selling shareholders.
The shares are tentatively scheduled to price in May for trading on the Nasdaq under the symbol "LHSG", according to lead underwriter Goldman Sachs & Co.
